tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and email background. Milly is light only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Item titles, the brief, the page date.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Item notes and running text under a title.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Dates over feed items, source lines, status lines. The email still uses #7a8089; settle on this one.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Masthead and footer rules, control borders.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Between items in a column.

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: The brief panel, secondary buttons, hover wells.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The house colour: the brand, school and home headings, their rule, links, the primary button.

tokens.name: green-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring, 4px offset.

tokens.name: child-1
tokens.usage: First child in name order: their heading, rule, tab, and the score line.

tokens.name: child-2
tokens.usage: Second child.

tokens.name: child-3
tokens.usage: Third child.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Words in a notice: a source not checked yet, a coverage gap.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Notice panel behind warn words.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: A source that failed. Not for emphasis.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The Daily Milly beside the dog, in green. 20px on a phone; 44px in the email header.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The day at the top of the page, in ink. 26px on a phone.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: The big name over a column: a school, a child, the home, the calendar. Always under a 5px rule in the same colour. Green, or the child's colour. 21px on a phone today (see README: one size per width is next). Class: heading.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: A group inside a column or panel: Today, To do, Prepare for tomorrow. Green or the child's colour, never a smaller size.

styles.name: item-title
styles.usage: What the item is. In ink. 17 to 18px in narrow columns.

styles.name: brief
styles.usage: The one or two sentences that open the Family and child pages, in ink.
styles.sample: Ava has a reading log due tomorrow; picture retakes are Friday.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: An item's note, in text. Stops near 70 characters.
styles.sample: Bring a signed form and a water bottle.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The date over a feed item, Source lines, status. In muted. 15px is the floor: nothing smaller.

spacing.note: Loose steps, taken from the live site.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: The rule over a column heading; 3px over a child on a wide screen.

tokens.name: rule-gap
tokens.usage: Rule to heading.

tokens.name: item-gap
tokens.usage: Between items, split by a hairline.

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: Between school columns on a wide screen.

tokens.name: gutter-phone
tokens.usage: Page side padding on a phone.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Widest the page gets, sidebar included.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of reading text.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons and the date control.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The brief panel and notices.

tokens.name: radius-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and menus.
